judge.rationale: The candidate is an incomplete work-in-progress that stops halfway through its own checklist. While it adds `ajv` to `package.json`, drafts the spec and acceptance tests, and compiles the schema inside `ToolRegistry.register`, it never actually implements input validation inside `ToolRegistry.execute`. As a result, three of the four tests in the newly added `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when run. Furthermore, dynamic `ToolDefinitionSource` caching via `WeakMap`, most of the required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the doc comment on `execute`, and all documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) are completely missing.
